card.name: Words just before 'appear' or 'emerge'
card.fires_on: The word or phrase right before a verb meaning something shows up, such as appear, arise, emerge, pop up or present itself. The subject noun, 'that', 'will' or 'pop' often carries the signal.

modes.label: Subject before appear
modes.description: A thing is named as the subject and the next word is expected to be 'appear' or 'emerge'.

modes.label: Linking word before arise
modes.description: A small word like 'that', 'will' or 'eventually' sits right before a verb of appearing.
modes.example: can be used on any new warts<< that>> arise during the course of treatment.

modes.label: Pop-up phrasing
modes.description: A word like 'popping' or 'pop' that leads into 'up' for something appearing.
modes.example: there will always be random things<< popping>> up, like forgetting passwords
